features.name: profitability_composite_score
features.description: Weighted composite of three ROA variants normalized to [0,1], capturing overall profitability from multiple accounting perspectives. Higher values indicate stronger earnings relative to assets.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth continuous profitability signal that linear SVM can use as a strong margin separator between financially healthy and distressed firms.

features.name: solvency_stress_index
features.description: Combines debt ratio and current liability to assets ratio to form a solvency stress measure. Higher values indicate greater financial stress from leverage and short-term obligations.
features.expected_model_benefit: Continuous leverage severity measure that provides a linear projection of financial distress risk useful for SVM margin optimization.

features.name: liquidity_coverage_ratio
features.description: Ratio of working capital to total assets minus current liability to assets, measuring net liquidity buffer. Higher values indicate stronger short-term financial cushion.
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalized liquidity measure that helps linear SVM distinguish firms with adequate working capital from those facing liquidity constraints.

features.name: cash_flow_strength_score
features.description: Weighted average of cash flow to total assets and CFO to assets, representing operational cash generation capacity relative to asset base.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth cash generation signal that linear SVM can leverage to identify firms with strong operational cash flows versus those with weak or negative flows.

features.name: equity_quality_index
features.description: Composite of net worth to assets and retained earnings to total assets, measuring equity quality and accumulated earnings strength.
features.expected_model_benefit: High-quality equity signal that provides a strong linear discriminant for firms with solid equity bases versus those with eroded equity positions.

features.name: operating_efficiency_score
features.description: Combines operating profit rate and gross profit to sales ratio to measure operational efficiency. Higher values indicate better cost management and pricing power.
features.expected_model_benefit: Operational efficiency composite that provides a smooth continuous feature for linear SVM to separate efficient from inefficient firms.

features.name: debt_coverage_adequacy
features.description: Ratio of cash flow to liability relative to debt ratio, measuring how well operating cash flows cover debt obligations. Higher values indicate better debt coverage.
features.expected_model_benefit: Debt coverage ratio that helps linear SVM identify firms with adequate cash flow to service debt versus those at risk of default.

features.name: asset_utilization_efficiency
features.description: Total asset turnover combined with quick assets to total assets ratio, measuring how efficiently assets are deployed to generate revenue and maintain liquidity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Asset efficiency composite useful for linear SVM to distinguish operationally efficient firms from those with underutilized or illiquid assets.

features.name: earnings_stability_score
features.description: Combines persistent EPS over last 4 seasons with after-tax net interest rate to measure earnings stability and consistency over time.
features.expected_model_benefit: Earnings stability measure that provides a smooth signal for linear SVM to identify firms with consistent earnings versus those with volatile or declining profits.

features.name: financial_distress_composite
features.description: Altman Z-score inspired composite using equity quality, profitability, and leverage signals normalized to a continuous distress severity scale. Lower values indicate higher distress.
features.expected_model_benefit: Comprehensive financial distress index that approximates a linear projection of bankruptcy risk, directly useful for SVM margin separation.

features.name: interest_coverage_quality
features.description: Semantic assessment of interest coverage adequacy combining interest coverage ratio and operating profit rate. Score from 0 (very poor coverage, high default risk) to 1 (excellent coverage, low default risk). Assessed based on whether interest coverage ratio exceeds 0.5 and operating profit rate exceeds 0.99.
features.expected_model_benefit: Interpretable interest coverage quality score that helps linear SVM identify firms with inadequate interest coverage as a key bankruptcy predictor.

features.name: capital_structure_health
features.description: Measures capital structure health by combining equity to liability ratio with net income to stockholders equity, penalized by current liabilities to equity. Higher values indicate healthier capital structure.
features.expected_model_benefit: Capital structure health index that provides a smooth continuous feature for linear SVM to separate firms with sound financing from those with problematic debt structures.
